source.assetPlacement: Six local connected OSM road nodes selected deterministically; supplier/reserve chosen to demonstrate a cycle detour
source.hazardMeaning: Synthetic storm slow zones on the supplier to reserve route. Roads touching a polygon are modelled at 50% (moderate) or 20% (severe) speed. This extent has too little spare road for a closure to leave a route, so a delay is modelled instead. Not a flood model.
